scientific_integrity: The line-orbit discriminant proof and independent homogeneous-resultant scan reconstruct exact geometric smoothness for all 64 x 31 restrictions, and the rational-point spectra follow by direct quadratic-character counts.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification restricted to 64 ordered nonzero diagonal quartic coefficient triples over F5; equation counts are not isomorphism class counts, and no claim concerns arbitrary plane quartics or other fields. Earlier pointless-curve results are not claimed new. The result has not received independent external validation.
title: The all-transverse diagonal quartic over \(\mathbf F_5\) and its anticanonical Bertini spectrum
